q.g: In this quest you first have to find a special storage module in the prototype weapon area inside The Labyrinth. Afterwards you have to stash a fragmentation grenade in the prototype weapon. Note: The F-1 hand grenade (Reduced delay) can't be used.

sh.c: Prototype weapon area marked on map
Spawn 1: On the tool trolley next to the whiteboard
Spawn 2: On the center table closest to the whiteboard
Spawn 3: Ontop the pallet next to the grate door
Spawn 4: On the center table closest to the laptop
Spawn 5: On the tool trolley next to the missile
Spawn 6: On the table next to the laptop
